item.title: Historic Reflection: 1960 – Wauseon Explosion
item.description: EXPLOSION… This week’s photo shows the Wauseon School explosion at the corner of Clinton and Elm Streets on March 19, 1960. Thank you to the Fulton County Historical Society for allowing us to use this photo. Do you have a historic Fulton County photo you’d like to share? Email: publisher@thevillagereporter.com. item.title: Historic Reflection: 1912 Kunkle School
item.description: Classes began in the southern section of the Kunkle school. The first schoolhouse in the Kunkle area was a wooden frame building erected around 1856 on the east side of County Road 17, a half-mile south of town. item.title: Raymond Sommers (1930 – 2026)
item.description: (Formerly Of Wauseon) Raymond Junior Sommers, age 95, of Neebish Island, Michigan, and formerly of Wauseon, passed away on January 7, 2026, at the McClarren Oakland Hospital in Pontiac Michigan. Raymond worked as a personnel manager at Perfection in Wauseon for over 30 years.
